label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Clark Leads BMW Championship
items.text: Wyndham Clark posted back-to-back bogey-free 6-under 64s at the BMW Championship, taking a solo lead ahead of a weekend that could boost his FedEx Cup standing.

items.headline: Westwood Slams McIlroy’s LIV Comment
items.text: LIV Golf's Lee Westwood criticized Rory McIlroy’s claim that LIV players don’t add value, calling the remark “typical of Rory” and “not well thought out.”

items.headline: Scheffler Nears Tour Earnings Record
items.text: Scottie Scheffler is closing in on PGA Tour history with over $100 million in career winnings, highlighting his dominance over the past four years.
